title: GPU rendering throughput bottleneck
fix_rationale: GPU frame time is most effectively reduced by lowering internal resolution scaling (TSR/DLSS/FSR) or tuning heavy feature passes like Lumen GI and Virtual Shadow Maps.
evidence_template: GPU stage duration took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time), outlasting CPU thread workloads.

fixes.text: Enable or tune Dynamic Resolution / Temporal Super Resolution (r.ScreenPercentage) for your target framerate.
Review Lumen and Reflection scalability settings in Project Settings.
Optimize shadow-casting lights and Virtual Shadow Map (VSM) resolution limits.

verify: Lower screen percentage or shadow quality and verify that GPU frame time decreases proportionally.
